dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The module describes the global production mix for jointly produced zinc- and lead-concentrates from sulphidic deposits. The multioutput-process “exploitation, zinc-lead-deposit” delivers the three co-products “lead, concentrate, at beneficiation” and “zinc, concentrate, at beneficiation”. It is designed for the use of the concentrates as raw material for the ultimate production of lead and zinc.; UUID: f0e2d755-01a0-31f5-8882-1abfcaac5297

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: This module represents a global production mix. Some agents used like lime or sodium cyanide originate from data sets valid for Switzerland or Europe. Processes like blasting and transport originate from data sets valid for Switzerland or Europe.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
This module is approximated with values from nickel-mining. Mining is assumed to be underground, followed by froth beneficiation. Overburden and tailings are disposed inside the mining panels. For electricity mix a mix of 25% coal and 75% gas fired plants was chosen.

# Included processes
The module includes the mining and the beneficiation step with the mining infrastructure and disposal of overburden and tailings (see part "Auxiliary Processes").
